lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiMn2F5 is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell of Li4Mn8F20 (32 atoms) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Li centers with six F neighbors, while Mn adopts octahedral coordination with six F neighbors across two independent orbits; one Mn orbit is recognized as octahedral with a Mn–F distance range of 1.8656–2.0002 Å. The same analysis finds corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and edge-sharing between Li 6-vertex polyhedra and Mn octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
